
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(duckdb)

propane_supply_rates <- read_csv("/workspaces/reports/data/fuel_costs/propane/ma_propane_supply_rates.csv")
fuel_oil_supply_rates <- read_csv("/workspaces/reports/data/fuel_costs/fuel_oil/ma_fuel_oil_supply_rates.csv")


path_rs_db <- '/workspaces/reports/data/ResStock/2022_resstock_amy2018_release_1.1/rs_ma_hp_rates_2.db'


# Write to database
con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), path_rs_db)
DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "supply_rates_propane", propane_supply_rates, overwrite = TRUE)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

# FUEL OIL
con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), path_rs_db)
DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "supply_rates_fueloil", fuel_oil_supply_rates, overwrite = TRUE)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

```
